title: How 4 AI Agents Run My Microcap Research | Kevin Schoovaerts
description:
Kevin is the founder of Atomical Capital, where he writes the 100 Bagger Hunting newsletter on under-the-radar microcaps and teaches investors to use Claude through Invest with AI. He trained in nuclear physics, has been investing for seventeen years, and has spent the last two years building AI into his research process.

This discussion took place on October 10th, 2026, on the MicroCapClub Community. Join MicroCapClub and unlock the ability to listen and participate live in these discussions - https://microcapclub.com/#join 
 
In this episode, Kevin explains how he built that process: Claude skills that use Python to keep the numbers reliable, and four agents that find ideas, write research, push back on his thesis and track his holdings, with him making the decision at every step. He shows how he screened 180 European banks in one pass and how his weekly thesis tracker flagged a broken position before he was ready to accept it. He also explains why investors still have to learn the fundamentals themselves before they hand any of the work to AI.
